sv.title: Malmöstudio kan vinna fyra priser på spelens Oscarsgala
sv.summary: För första gången kan ett spel skapat i Malmö vinna pris som ”Årets spel” på spelvärldens stora internationella prisgala The Game Awards. Malmöstudion IO Interactive kan vinna hela fyra priser för sitt James Bond-spel på galan i december.

en.title: Malmö studio could win four prizes at the games' Oscars gala
en.summary: For the first time, a game made in Malmö can win the prize for "Game of the Year" at The Game Awards, the major international prize gala of the gaming world. Malmö studio IO Interactive could win as many as four prizes for its James Bond game at the gala in December.
